title: QUIC RFC 9000 S19P20 HANDSHAKE_DONE Proof Tail Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P20 requirement-home tests over HANDSHAKE_DONE frame type encoding, parser rejection behavior, trailing-frame consumption, server-only send gating, completion-boundary send timing, one-shot send behavior, and server receipt PROTOCOL_VIOLATION handling, followed by Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the focused generated S19P20 hard proof tail for HANDSHAKE_DONE frame type encoding, server-only emission, completion-boundary send timing, and server-side receipt error policy.
expected_result: The focused tests show that HANDSHAKE_DONE formats as the single-byte varint value 0x1e, parser rejection covers adjacent and non-minimal encodings, parsing consumes exactly the type byte before a following frame, clients do not emit HANDSHAKE_DONE, servers emit exactly one HANDSHAKE_DONE only after peer handshake transcript completion, and servers close with PROTOCOL_VIOLATION when receiving HANDSHAKE_DONE while keeping non-HANDSHAKE_DONE protected packets open.
procedure: Run the focused S19P20 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: HANDSHAKE_DONE remains parsed and formatted through QuicFrameCodec.
The server send path remains gated by role, peer handshake transcript completion, active path availability, 1-RTT protect material, and the one-shot handshakeDonePacketSent flag.
The application-data receive path dispatches HANDSHAKE_DONE before ordinary connection-close and path-management frame handling.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim broad S19 frame-family closure, public API widening, hosted interop readiness, or closure of unrelated deferred fuzz obligations.

status_summary: Local verification on 2026-05-06 passed: focused S19P20 requirement-home filter 13/13; Release build 0 warnings/errors; regenerated QUIC coverage triage 1,330/1,771 trace-clean; SpecTrace core validation 502 artifacts; full Release no-build suite 4,609/4,609; git diff --check exited 0 with only CRLF normalization warnings for generated triage files.
